crossRefs.note: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

people.name: Rome
people.line: Capital city of the Roman Empire

translations.web: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”
translations.bsb: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes,” he answered.
translations.kjv: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
translations.asv: And the chief captain came and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? And he said, Yea.
